name: check_stock
description: Look up whether a product is in stock right now. Pass only the product name or character, not the caller's whole sentence.

query.description: Product name, character, or line to search for. Example: 'batman', 'gotham knights robin'.

name: check_order_status
description: Look up an order by order number or by the email used to place it. Never invent either value - if the caller has not given one, ask.

order_number.description: Order number as the caller said it, digits only. Empty string if not provided.

email.description: Email on the order, normalized (e.g. 'jane at example dot com' becomes 'jane@example.com'). Empty string if not provided.

name: check_loyalty_points
description: Look up a customer's loyalty point balance by email.

name: log_callback_request
description: Record that a caller needs a human to call them back. Use for buy/sell inquiries, bulk orders, and anything outside the other tools.

contact.description: Phone number or email to reach them.
